title: Bath Time for the Puppy | Kids Song, Nursery Rhymes, Rhymes for Toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
A muddy puppy gets a big bubbly bath, then shakes off all the water in a splashy surprise!
This fun rhyme teaches children about cleanliness, sharing laughter, and cozy towel time.
Sing along and wiggle your hands in the bubbles!

La la la, la la la, la la la, la la la
Puppy's muddy, muddy, mud
Kids fill the tub with warm water
Wash, wash, wash, wash, in the tub!
Puppy's ready for a bath!
Rub a dub, bubbles up
Scrub, scrub, scrub, clean puppy
Scrub, scrub, scrub, scrub, suds on the nose!
Shiny white puppy!
Shake, shake, shake, the puppy jumps
Splish, splash, all over the place
Splash, splash, splash, splash, on sister and Amma!
Everyone is wet, wet, wet!
Rub a dub, bubbles up
Scrub, scrub, scrub, clean puppy
Scrub, scrub, scrub, scrub, suds on the nose!
Shiny white puppy!
Everyone is wet and laughing
Ha ha ha, hee hee hee
Amma, Amma, wrap him up, soft towel!
Snuggly puppy, cozy and warm!
Rub a dub, bubbles up
Scrub, scrub, scrub, clean puppy
Scrub, scrub, scrub, scrub, suds on the nose!
Shiny white puppy!
Clean and fluffy, fluffy, fluffy
Kids give a big hug
Hug, hug, hug, hug, puppy's happy!
Bath time is done, yay!
